resources.string: Connect privately, then open your sprinkler controls.

1. Tap Connect Tailscale.
2. In Tailscale, connect or sign in if prompted.
3. Return here using Android Back or Recent apps.

This launcher checks again when you return and opens Sprinklers when reachable. You still use the normal sprinkler web password.
No VPN passwords are stored. No sprinkler commands are sent. A connection failure can also mean the controller computer is unavailable.
Return here after connecting Tailscale. Checking for up to about a minute…
Sprinklers opened in your browser. To open it again, tap Check connection / Open Sprinklers.
Tailscale is not installed or cannot be opened. Use Get Tailscale, sign in, then return here.
No browser could be opened. Install or enable a browser, then try again.
Could not reach Sprinklers. %1$s\n\nConnect Tailscale and return here. If it is already connected, check that the controller computer is on and the phone web service is running.
